summary: Juvenile male from Texas tripped hiking down Deer Mountain trail, suffering a significant injury; litter carry-out to an awaiting ambulance at the trailhead, then flown by Flight for Life to Children's Hospital.
location: Deer Mountain Trail, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Source: Estes Park News, "Six Incidents in Rocky Mountain National Park on Tuesday, August 14, 2012" — one of six same-day RMNP incidents; the Broadway Ledge pair from the same article is id 3086.
